name: Corn on the Cob with Husks
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Corn on the cob, with husks left on

steps: Carefully peel back husk without detaching it and remove silk.
Replace husks and soak ears in cold water for ½ hour.
Place corn on grill or on a rack above an open fire.
Cook for about 15 minutes, turning occasionally to ensure even cooking.
